messages.subject: Category and sub category aggregation.
messages.body_plain:
I have data that looks like:

1
  A 1
  B 2
  C 3
  C 1
2
 A 5
 B 6
 C 1
3
 A 3
 B 4
 C 2

In a data frame this would look like
1 A 1
1 B 2
1 C 3
1 C 1
2 A 5
2 B 6
2 C 1
3 A 3
3 B 4
3 C 2

If I were to aggregate this by category I would get a data frame with 3 rows (summing all of the sub categories):

1 7
2 12
3 9

I have been able to use reshape to get thiese results just fine. Now I want to aggregate by category and sub category. So for the data above I would expect 9 rows:
1 A 1
1 B 2
1 C 4
2 A 5
2 B 6
2 C 1
3 A 3
3 B 4
3 C 2

I was wondering how would be the best way to use plyr or reshape to aggegate the data by category and sub category while still outputing the category and subcategory?

Thank you.

Kevin
